# 春秋權衡

## Authors / Editors
- 劉敞 (宋朝) 撰 1019 - 1068

**Editions:** WYG

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Chūnqiū quán héng* 春秋權衡 in seventeen juan is the foundational work of Liú Chǎng's [劉敞](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%8A%89%E6%95%9E) (1019–1068) *Chūnqiū* programme. It is the first of the three works in his trilogy: *Quán héng* (the critical adjudication of the three commentaries), *Liúshì Chūnqiū zhuàn* ([KR1e0022](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1e/KR1e0022), the running commentary), and *Yì lín* ([KR1e0023](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1e/KR1e0023), the supplementary essays). His brother Liú Bān 劉攽 (1023–1089) records in the *xíng zhuàng* (deeds-narrative) and Ōuyáng Xiū 歐陽修 in the tomb-inscription that Liú composed five *Chūnqiū* works in total — the *zhuàn* in 15 juan, the *Quán héng* in 17, the *Shuō lì* 說例 ([KR1e0024](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1e/KR1e0024)) in 2, the *Wén quán* 文權 in 2, and the *Yì lín* in 5 — though the *Yì lín* now exists in only 2 juan. The Sìkù base is the WYG print.

**Abstract**

The *Sìkù tíyào* makes the principal points: that this is the first and most theoretically pointed of Liú Chǎng's three principal *Chūnqiū* works — composed before the running commentary [KR1e0022](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1e/KR1e0022) and the supplementary essays [KR1e0023](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1e/KR1e0023); that Liú's hermeneutical position breaks decisively with Sūn Fù's pure speculation by anchoring its judgements in the canonical ritual code, an approach Yè Mèngdé would later identify as the genuinely productive Sòng *xīnyì* line; that Liú's own self-assessment is exceptionally high.

The *Quán héng*'s methodology — weighing each *zhuàn* on a *jīng*-by-*jīng* basis to identify which is correct on which point, rather than picking a single commentary as primary — is the structurally important departure from both the Hàn-Táng *zhùshū* tradition (which followed one commentary as primary) and the Dàn-Zhào-Lù school (which set all three aside). It is, in effect, the methodological foundation of all subsequent eclectic *Chūnqiū* commentary.
